biggest_catch: The $500 is a BUSINESS checking bonus (not personal), and eligibility requires you to have reached the offer through a direct communication from Fulton Bank — plus you must be a business that hasn't had Fulton business checking in the last 24 months.
catches: This is a business checking bonus: you must open a Fulton Bank Business Checking account as a business customer — personal checking does not qualify (Fulton's personal offer is a separate $400 Simply Checking bonus).

To be eligible, you must have accessed the offer page via a direct communication (digital ad) from Fulton Bank; to open in a financial center, request the coupon by email and bring it in with promo code 26BIZ500.

Open the account by December 31, 2026; deposit at least $5,000 of new money within 60 days (micro-deposits, refunds, and transfers from other Fulton accounts do not count); enroll in online statements within 60 days.
New Fulton Bank business checking customers only — no business checking account with Fulton Bank, N.A. within the last 24 months.

Limited to one $500 bonus per business entity (TIN/EIN or business address); IOLTA and non-profit accounts are not eligible; Fulton Financial Corporation employees and household family members are not eligible.
Fulton Bank does not offer products and services outside its service area (DE, DC, MD, NJ, PA, VA).
$25 minimum deposit to open online; account must not be closed when the bonus is paid.
Offer may be withdrawn without notice; possible tax implications (1099).

steps: Access the offer through a direct communication from Fulton Bank (digital ad), or request the coupon by email for in-branch opening with promo code 26BIZ500.
Open a new Fulton Bank Business Checking account by December 31, 2026 (online, or in a financial center with the printed coupon).
Deposit at least $5,000 of new money within 60 days of account opening (transfers from other Fulton Bank accounts, micro-deposits, and refunds do not count).
Enroll in online statements through Small Business Online Banking or the mobile app within 60 days of opening.
Keep the account open; the $500 bonus is credited within four to six weeks after all conditions are met.
